item.name: Pull all changes since a timestamp

request.name: Pull all changes since a timestamp

description.content: Returns every record from every syncable table changed after `since` (inclusive of soft-deleted rows, which appear under `deleted`). `since` is an ISO-8601 timestamp; omit it to do a full sync. Store `server_time` and use it as `since` on the next pull.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Send all pending offline changes grouped by table. Each change carries a client-generated `local_id`, an optional `server_id` (null for new records) and the `server_lock_version` the client last saw.
- A matching `server_lock_version` → record created/updated/soft-deleted
  (`accepted`).
- A stale version → no data is written; a conflict is stored server-side
  for admin review and returned under `conflicts`.
- Validation failures → returned under `rejected` with field errors.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

variable.description: Sanctum bearer token returned by POST /login. Auto-captured after running the Login request.

description.content:
Backend API for the plastic recycling operations mobile app.
All endpoints except `POST /api/login` require a Sanctum bearer token issued by the login endpoint. Send it as:

    Authorization: Bearer <token>

Derived values (net weight, totals, amounts, loss percentages, dashboard metrics) are always computed server-side — never trust or send them from the client.
The `sync/pull` and `sync/push` endpoints implement offline-online sync with optimistic locking (`lock_version`). See the companion `api-reference.md` for the full mobile integration guide.
